web_fixture.title: API deprecation schedule - Larkspur Mail Developers
web_fixture.snippet: The legacy /v1/aliases endpoint will be removed in API version 11; /v1/aliases/expand follows in API version 12.
web_fixture.content:
# API deprecation schedule - Larkspur Mail Developers

Effective 2026-09-08. Legacy endpoints keep working until the version listed
below removes them.
The legacy /v1/aliases endpoint will be removed in API version 11; /v1/aliases/expand follows in API version 12.

| endpoint | deprecated since | removed in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| /v1/aliases | v9 | API version 11 |
| /v1/aliases/expand | v9 | API version 12 |
| /v1/mailboxes.raw | v7 | API version 10 |

Migrate to /v2/addresses before your tenant's cutover.

web_fixture.content:
# Preparing for the Larkspur v9 cutover

maildevnotes.example, 2026-03-15.

Version 9 retires the old alias handling on the sandbox clusters. The /v1
alias endpoints have been deprecated since v9; plan your migration before the
cutover window so the sandbox retirement does not catch your staging jobs.

turns.prompt: Our notification service still calls the legacy /v1/aliases endpoint on the Larkspur Mail API. Per the vendor's deprecation schedule, in which API version will that endpoint be removed? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label.
